chunks: Muhammad ibn Isma'il, from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Mansur ibn Hazim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), that he said:

Regarding a man who fasted during the two months of Sha'ban, then the month of Ramadan caught up with him, he said: He should fast Ramadan and resume the fasting. So if he fasted during the two months and added one day to the half, he has fulfilled the remainder.

key_terms.رَمَضَانَ: Ramadan (the ninth month of the Islamic calendar)
key_terms.شَعْبَانَ: Sha'ban (the eighth month of the Islamic calendar)
key_terms.ظِهَار: Zihar (a form of expiation requiring fasting)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for someone whose two-month consecutive fast was interrupted by Ramadan?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* addresses the specific fiqh of *kaffarat al-ghayz* (expiation for accidental intercourse) when interrupted by Ramadan, establishing that the fasting month itself counts toward the two-month obligation. It highlights the Shia scholarly view on the continuity of expiation, noting that if the individual fasted part of the period before Ramadan, they must complete the remainder after Ramadan, ensuring the total count of two consecutive months is met. This ruling underscores the flexibility in Islamic jurisprudence regarding the interruption of continuous acts of worship by obligatory ones.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al Fazl Bin Shazaan, from Safwan Bin Yahya, from Mansour Bin Hazim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>

having said regarding a man who Fasts Shaban regarding Zihaar, the he sees the Month of Ramazan, (Imamasws) said: ‘He should Fast Ramazaan, and he resumes the Fasting. So if he had Fasted regarding the Zihaar of an increase in the half by a day, he can make up for it for his remainder’.
en.sarwar: 5. Muhammad ibn ‘Isma‘il has narrated from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan from Safwan ibn Yahya from Mansur who has said the following: “

About a man who fasts because of Zihar in the month of al-Sha‘ban, then the month of Ramadan comes; abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘He is required to fast the month of Ramadan, then resume the fast. If because of Zihar he fasted for more than half by one day he completes only Qada’ (compensatory fast) of the rest.’”
